notes.note: Ambiguity: structured types are not parameterizable (table 2, 5.4.1.1 a); test covers parameterized template, function, altstep and testcase only.
Negative test uses the non-existent parameter kind 'in out'; this is ultimately a syntax violation, as no other kinds exist in the BNF.
Tested as reject: passing a value of an incompatible record type (different number of fields) to an in parameter.

Titan accepts passing an integer variable to an inout MyInt (subtype) parameter. Per the strong typing definition in 3.1 (type name equivalence with no exceptions), the types differ, so the test is kept as reject.
Non-inheritance observed with isbound() on the out parameter before it is set.
Titan does not support the @deterministic modifier (syntax error); the syntax follows FormalValuePar in annex A.

8.2.1 allows template module parameters, so 'value parameterization only' is tested as: a module parameter without template modifier shall be initialized with a value (8.2.1 f); a matching mechanism is rejected.
'Static at start of runtime' is tested via its consequence that module parameters are not changeable at runtime (assignment rejected, 8.2.1 a).
Ambiguity: omission in table 2 read as a prohibition (consistent with 5.4.1.1 l); only the timer type is tested.
Ambiguity: 'it' read as the fuzzy parameter of the preceding sentence; test passes a fuzzy parameter to a lazy formal parameter.
